    AI Overview
    Yes, Real Madrid has been eliminated from the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League. They were knocked out in the quarterfinals by Bayern Munich on April 15, 2026, losing 6-4 on aggregate (4-3 in the second leg). As confirmed in reports from The New York Times and Real Madrid CF, late goals in Munich sealed their exit. 
    Key details regarding their exit include: 
    • Aggregate Score: Bayern Munich won 6-4 across the two legs.
    • Second Leg Score: Bayern won 4-3 at the Allianz Arena.
    • Impact: This defeat marks a potential second consecutive season without a major trophy for Real Madrid.
    • Crucial Moment: A late red card for Real Madrid's Eduardo Camavinga preceded the final deciding goals from Bayern. 
    Bayern Munich advances to the semifinals to face Paris Saint-Germain.
